body:
> I do not know the specific behavior that we want here (I am not familiar with the LicenseUtils.signatureNeedsUpdate work). 

The intended functionality was to update the signature because the new license spec format. I think the problem stemmed from my incomplete overview of license types ( i.e. the existence of long term registered trial licenses.)

> Maybe if the license is not self generated, we want to reuse the expiration date opposed to the issue date + self generated duration (30 days)?

I, now, think we can handle both self generated and registered trial licenses in the same manner. Just update the signature and reuse the expiration date from the original trial license. I'll push a PR shortly

issue.title: Reuse expiration date of trial licenses

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
While updating the license signature to the new license spec, keep
the trial license expiration date to that of the existing license
irrespective to whether this was a self generated or a registered
one.

Resolves #30882
